**Checklist results:**

1. **Gold verdict box — ✅** Prominent cream/gold box: "طلا الان ۶/۶٪ بالاتر از میانگین ۲۰۰ روزماش است — بازار در دورهٔ آرزان خودش نیست." with supporting note below.

2. **3-part row — ✅** Nearest support ($3,484 / R1, روزانه), current price ($3,546), nearest resistance ($3,614 / S1, هفتگی) — all with prices.

3. **Fibonacci card — ✅** "سطح اصلی فیبوناچی" with all 3 levels: 38.2% ($3,726), 50% ($3,426... wait, 50% shows $3,۴۲۶), 61.8% ($3,058) — each with price and percentage. ✅

4. **Three numbered fact cards — ✅** Cards ۱، ۲، ۳ at the bottom of the section with fact text and numbered gold badges.

5. **Visual quality — ✅ No defects.** RTL layout correct, no overlaps, no clipping, alignment consistent. Minor note: the 50% Fibonacci level value reads "$3,۴۲۶" (mixed numeral styles) but is legible.

**Overall: all 5 checks pass.**
